changelog: A pass over the interface: a sync started from an item page now shows up in History, the single-item dialog is the same form as the series dialog (a language filter, one subtitle picker, one Sync, a Close that stays visible), the run box states what is left and roughly how long, progress is a list of results instead of terminal output, a click adds to a selection instead of replacing it, picked rows sort to the top, every sync button states a number of subtitles, and History is a grouped list with a problems-only filter and Copy as text
description: Synchronize subtitles with video audio using ffsubsync
name: SubSync
overview: Adds a Sync Subtitles action to any video, using ffsubsync as backend
